run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset point with structural relaxation and force constant computation
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE atoms or pymatgen Structure with displacement generation
produce_force_constants: compute forces and produce force constants from a Phonopy object using an ASE calculator
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies at supercell commensurate qpoints or a custom set of qpoints
calculate_thermal_properties: calculate vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity using Fourier interpolation on a qpoint mesh
